summary: No actionable defects found. The page-load passkey banner is removed; passkey-only guidance remains in the invalid-credentials path for non-passkey mode, and the backup-password flow is unchanged.

evidence: `public/auth.js:433-435` now only sets the password label, so `setPasswordLabelForMode` no longer writes a standing banner into `#status` on password-mode page load.

`public/auth.js:370-378` appends `passkeyUnavailableMessage` only for `invalid_credentials` outside `managePassword` and `settingBackupPassword`, reaching failed password attempts and passkey-only accounts when it applies.
`public/auth.js:417-430` leaves `requireBackupPassword` and the skip/save backup-password flow intact, and no test asserts the removed hardcoded copy.
